narrative.structure: episodic predation giving way to dissolution

visualStyle.color: grey Scotland vs. pure black voids

analysis.themes: An alien predator harvesting men gradually develops something like empathy — the film watches humanity from outside until the outside starts to crack.
analysis.atmosphere: Cold, hypnotic unease; Glasgow streets filmed like an alien survey, and void sequences of pure uncanny dread.
analysis.narrative: Episodic hunts slowly give way to the creature's unraveling — minimal dialogue, maximum visual implication.
analysis.visual: Hidden-camera documentary realism collides with abstract black-void imagery; few films look this genuinely extraterrestrial.
analysis.characters: The protagonist is a consciousness wearing a body — her 'character arc' is the slow, fatal acquisition of human feeling.
